test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Manish starts from Point Y and drives 37 km towards North. He then takes a left turn, drives 75 km, turns left and drives 69 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 52 km. He takes a left turn, drives 32 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Manish starts from Point Y.

Movement details:

37 km North

Left turn → 75 km West

Left turn → 69 km South

Left turn → 52 km East

Left turn → 32 km North

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0a2e822c0371c24f1695744a02c5b473a3235d7cc31e2b7224d973a44552c44.png] 

If Point Z is 23 km West of Point Y, then to reach Point Y again he must travel:

**23 km towards East**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
